TutoExplainContent: This activity helps you explore how an Abacus works. An Abacus is a mechanical counting tool developed by ancient civilizations like the Romans and Chinese.
TutoAbacusContent: Click here to select the type of Abacus. You can use different versions, such as decimal, fraction, or even create a custom one.
TutoCustomContent: Click here to create a custom Abacus. You can set the number of rods, lines, and even change the base system (e.g., base 2, base 10).
TutoCopyContent: Click here to copy the current value of the Abacus to your clipboard for easy sharing.
TutoClearContent: Click here to reset the Abacus to zero.
TutoCanvasContent: This is the Abacus. Click or drag the beads towards the center to change the number.
